title: docs(skills,adr): `homeAmount.rateDate` is `date`/`datetime`, the `currency` row lists all four `currencyConfig` keys, and ADR-0144 Open item 1 records the settled pointer spelling

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DU2BHFXKvCJE9K2bko2dD6o)_

Fixes #28203

Clause-②: no (authoring text and a dated ADR note catch up to what PR #28096 already shipped; no schema, accept set, error code or public surface changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`field-types.md` 的 `homeAmount` 段把 `rateDate` 写成 `date`/`datetime`；Numbers 表 `currency` 行列出 `currencyConfig` 的全部四个键；ADR-0144 Open item 1 加 2026-10-31 注记，记下 PR #28096 定下的拼写 `rateDate` / `rateField`。
- 为什么改：PR #28096 的契约复审 6526217217 should-fix 3–5：spec 接受 `date` 与 `datetime`（`HOME_AMOUNT_RATE_DATE_TYPES`），skill 只教了 `date`；行里只列了两个键，违反本文件「配置列只列真实键」的规则；ADR 写明「每个答案落地后本记录随之修订」。
- 风险与回滚：只改作者指引文字与 ADR 注记，没有代码、schema 或 changeset。ADR 原文按 Prime Directive #13 保留，注记追加在条目下。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0144-*.md` 的 Open item 1 注记，与 `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` 的两处单行改动。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`（field-types.md 3191 / 3207）与 `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`（2852 → 2855 个锚点全部解析）。
- 需要你做的：契约复审（CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER）尚欠，由席位安排；本 PR 为 Tier H，需要治理审批人（os-zhuang 或 hotlong）批准，并由维护者手动合并。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`
  - The `homeAmount` paragraph says `rateDate` names a `date`/`datetime` field (was `date`), matching `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts#HOME_AMOUNT_RATE_DATE_TYPES` (`new Set(['date', 'datetime'])`) and the `rateDate` describe in `HomeAmountSchema` ("a `date` or `datetime` field"). One line re-wrapped to keep the paragraph's width.
  - The Numbers table `currency` row lists `currencyConfig` as `(currencyMode, defaultCurrency, currencyField, homeAmount)`: the four keys of `CurrencyConfigSchema` at `origin/main` `57f8ca2f`, which is a closed `strictObject` with exactly those keys.
- `docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md`: Open item 1 gains a `*Note (2026-10-31):*` in the same form as the item 11, 12 and 13 notes: settled as `rateDate` / `rateField` in PR #28096 (`73b72709`), the three pointers required with no default, `rateDate` a `date` or `datetime` field, `rateField` a `number` field, both stored fields `readonly: true`. The recorded item text is kept unchanged. Three new `path#symbol` anchors: `field.zod.ts#HomeAmountSchema`, `object.zod.ts#HOME_AMOUNT_RATE_DATE_TYPES`, `object.zod.ts#refuseDishonestHomeAmount`.

## Why

Should-fixes 3, 4 and 5 of triage contract review [`6526217217`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/28096#issuecomment-6526217217) on PR #28096 (card #27191). They were left out so the reviewed head could land unchanged.

- Token ratchet: `field-types.md` 3181 → 3191 tokens against a ceiling of 3207 (headroom 26 → 16). The +10 tokens (+39 bytes) fit the existing headroom, so no ceiling raise and no restatement cut were needed.
- `check:adr-symbol-anchors` exit 0: base 2852 anchors (604 declaration) → head 2855 (607 declaration), all resolve. `check:adr-links` exit 0, 944 → 944. `adr-index --report` OK, `docs/adr/README.md` current (not regenerated). `check:adr-anchors` exit 0.
- `check:pm-skill-id-lint` exit 0, `check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the committed head `eb4b9762` derives 39 families. All 39 ran in this worktree after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` and a packages build, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciles 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- No changeset: the `skip-changeset` label is added (authoring text and ADR only).
